title: Seasonal buying cooperative onboarding
background: A fictional wholesale cooperative links supplier accounts to legal organizations. A regional tax registration is intended to identify an organization within its issuing authority; store locations remain distinct operational records.
observations: Existing sources mostly provide registration authority and tax number. New cross-border feeds often omit authority, transliterate names differently, and list a buying agent contact shared by many suppliers.
The scorer produces a single pooled score. Operations describes 0.9 as a ninety-percent chance of a correct supplier association; no independent calibration study is available.
Training positives and the monthly accuracy panel are generated by the same tax-number and contact rules. A handful of manually investigated disputes were all found after delivery failures.
The integration team can keep source metadata or strip it for a smaller interface. A deadline encourages enabling all incoming feeds together.
constraints: Wrong supplier identity can redirect purchase orders. Keeping a feed in a separate review lane is operationally possible.
No source-specific review budget or independent outcome labels have been allocated.
request: Recommend a bounded onboarding and comparison plan, including which information the interface should retain and what would justify keeping or changing the scorer.
